mechanics.title: Settings
mechanics.description: Four options: drop with a pickaxe (default on), require silk touch (default off), spawn egg also drops (default on), XP drops (default off).

vanilla_changes.change: A mined spawner drops as an item (default: any pickaxe; silk touch only is an option). A spawn egg for the mob also drops by default. XP drop is off by default.

getting_started: Mine a spawner with a pickaxe. Use /trigger to change the rules.
editor_notes: Defaults are from the Modrinth text, which is partly inconsistent about the old and new settings; verify in-game. The /trigger and /scoreboard commands may need operator permission.
name: Mineable Spawner
summary: Monster spawners can be mined and picked up with a pickaxe. It is a datapack-style mod whose behavior is controlled by scoreboard/trigger settings.
